summary: Pyrophyte Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting routine monthly deposits into its trust account as part of a previously disclosed one-year extension of its business combination deadline. The sponsor deposited $100,000 for each of June and July 2026, funding the second and third months of the extension. This is a standard SPAC extension compliance update, not a standalone special situation event. No new deal terms, pricing, or strategic actions are disclosed. The filing merely confirms ongoing extension funding, with no indication of an imminent business combination, liquidation, or other transformative event. Watch for future announcements regarding the potential initial business combination or trust account status.
